n-m-e3-s2b-01.title: Ukwenza inani eliphakathi kwepizza enye neepizza ezimbini ngamaqhezu anomhluli ofanayo
n-m-e3-s2b-01.topic: Amaqhezu (amaqhezu angafanelekanga namaqhezu omnye, ubukhulu bamaqhezu: amaqhezu aphakathi kwe-1 ne-2)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.goal: Hlola ngemizekelo emininzi xa inani eliphezulu leqhezu elinomhluli ofanayo liliqhezu libe likhulu kuno-1 kwaye lincinci kuno-2, uze uthi amaqhezu asemaphethelweni angawoluphi uhlangothi.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.material: Iqela likaSeoa lahlulahlula ipizza egaywe yaba ziziqwenga ezilinganayo. Ukuba ipizza enye yahlulwa ngokulinganayo yaba ziziqwenga ezi-4, isiqwenga esinye yi-1/4 yepizza. Sibhala iziqwenga ezi-3 njenge-3/4 yepizza kunye neziqwenga ezi-5 njenge-5/4 yepizza. Iqhezu elinenani eliphezulu elikhulu kunomhluli walo libizwa ngokuba liqhezu elingafanelekanga.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.0: Ukugqiba ukuba amaxabiso asemaphethelweni (ipizza enye ncam, iipizza ezimbini ncam) ahambelana nemeko na
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.1: Ukwenza nokuhlola imizekelo ngendlela efanayo kubahluli abaninzi
n-m-e3-s2b-01.thinking.2: Ukubala imizekelo nokujonga ukuba akukho eshiyiweyo okanye ebaliwe ngaphezu kwexesha elinye
n-m-e3-s2b-01.prereq.0: Ukufunda iqhezu njengesiqingatha sonke nenxalenye (3 kwi-4, njalo njalo)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.prompt: Ipizza enye yahlulwa ngokulinganayo yaba ziziqwenga ezi-4. Leliphi kula maqhezu ingezantsi elingaphezulu kwepizza enye?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba umfanekiso, wahlule ipizza enye ibe ziziqwenga ezi-4, uze uthambise inani leziqwenga kukhetho ngalunye.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa inani leziqwenga kwipizza enye nenani leziqwenga kukhetho ngalunye, ecaleni komnye.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.a: Iziqwenga ezi-3 azizalisanga ipizza enye yonke, kodwa usenokuba ucinge ukuba zininzi ngokujonga nje inani leziqwenga.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.b: Esi sicinezelo sibala iqhezu elilingana ncam nepizza enye njenge-"ngaphezulu kwepizza enye."
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.c: Esi sicinezelo sifumene imeko apho inani leziqwenga lingaphezulu kwenani leziqwenga ezenza ipizza enye.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.r.d: Esi sicinezelo sibone ngathi zininzi nangona inani leziqwenga lincinci. Ziziqwenga ezingaphi ezenza ipizza enye?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s1.explain: Ipizza enye yiziqwenga ezi-4. Iziqwenga ezi-5 yipizza enye (iziqwenga ezi-4) kunye nesiqwenga esi-1, ngoko ingaphezulu kwepizza enye. Iziqwenga ezi-4 yipizza enye ncam, kwaye iziqwenga ezi-3 okanye ezi-2 zingaphantsi kwepizza enye.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.prompt: Khetha umhluli osuka kwi-3 ukuya kwi-9 wenze amaqhezu angafanelekanga ama-4 ahlukeneyo a/b angaphezulu kwepizza enye kwaye angaphantsi kweepizza ezimbini. (Umhluli ngu-b kwaye inani eliphezulu ngu-a.)
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha umhluli uqale ubhale ukuba ipizza enye yahlulwa yaba ziziqwenga ezingaphi.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala inani leziqwenga kwipizza enye nakwiipizza ezimbini, uze ukhethe inani eliphezulu eliphakathi kwazo.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.hint.2: Kwiqhezu ngalinye owalenzileyo, hlola ngokuthelekisa inani eliphezulu nenani leziqwenga kwipizza enye nakwiipizza ezimbini.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Umhluli linani lemvelo elisuka kwi-3 ukuya kwi-9.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda wenze b libe linani lemvelo elisuka kwi-3 ukuya kwi-9.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Inani eliphezulu likhulu kunomhluli, ngoko ingaphezulu kwepizza enye.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kufuneka ibe ngaphezulu kwepizza enye. Inani eliphezulu kufuneka libe likhulu kunomhluli (inani leziqwenga kwipizza enye).
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Kufuneka ibe ngaphantsi kweepizza ezimbini. Inani eliphezulu kufuneka libe lincinci kunamaxesha ama-2 enani leziqwenga kwipizza enye.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s2.explain: Ukuba umhluli ngu-b, ipizza enye iziqwenga ezi-b. Ukuba inani eliphezulu likhulu kuno-b kwaye lincinci kuno-2b, lihlangabezana neemeko. Ukuba inani eliphezulu lilingana no-b okanye u-2b, yipizza enye ncam okanye iipizza ezimbini ncam, ngoko likhutshiwe kwimeko ethi "ngaphezulu nangaphantsi."
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwamaqhezu anomhluli ongu-6, mangaphi onke angaphezulu kwepizza enye nangaphantsi kweepizza ezimbini?
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala amaqhezu anomhluli ongu-6 ngolandelelwano, anamanani aphezulu asuka kwi-5 ukuya kwi-13.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kroza awo ayipizza enye ncam neepizza ezimbini ncam, ubale eseleyo.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.a: Esi sicinezelo sibale iqhezu elinye ngaphezulu eliselucingweni, nokuba yipizza enye okanye iipizza ezimbini.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.b: Esi sicinezelo sibale nawo amaqhezu alingana nepizza enye neepizza ezimbini.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.c: Esi sicinezelo siphosise iqhezu elinye elihlangabezana nemeko. Bhala amanani aphezulu ngolandelelwano uqale kwawo makhulu kuno-6.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.r.d: Esi sicinezelo sishiye iimida sabala wonke amanani aphezulu aphakathi kwazo.
n-m-e3-s2b-01.s.s3.explain: Zi-5, ezinamanani aphezulu 7, 8, 9, 10, no-11. I-6/6 yipizza enye ncam kwaye i-12/6 ziipizza ezimbini ncam, ngoko aziquketyelwanga.

n-m-e3-s1-03.title: Ngaba ukwahlula nako kuyafana xa utshintsha ucwangciso, njengokuphindaphinda?
n-m-e3-s1-03.topic: Ukwahlula (ukwabelana ngokulinganayo, ubudlelwane phakathi kokuphindaphinda nokwahlula)

n-m-e3-s1-03.material: USua uthe oku: "3×8=24 kwaye 8×3=24. Ekuphindaphindeni ufumana impendulo efanayo xa utshintshisa ucwangciso. Ngoko ukwahlula kuya kufana xa utshintshisa ucwangciso nako." Ukwahlula 12÷3 kuthetha izinto ezili-12 zabelwana ngazo ngokulinganayo ngabantu aba-3.

n-m-e3-s1-03.thinking.1: Vavanya isiqendu ngokwenza umzekelo ochasayo wena
n-m-e3-s1-03.prereq.1: Yazi ukuba ukwahlula kuthetha ukwabelana ngokulinganayo
n-m-e3-s1-03.prereq.2: Ekuphindaphindeni, imveliso ifana xa utshintshisa ucwangciso
n-m-e3-s1-03.s.s1.prompt: Sifuna ukufumanisa ukuba oko kuthethwe nguSua kuchanekile na. Yeyiphi indlela elungileyo?
